title: Recommended!
text:
We loved this tour from start to finish. 

We travel a family of 5 in a 4x4 car, the road is quite curved I recommend drinking something for dizziness.

We loved the visit to the indigenous community, our guide Juan was charming, he showed us his home, his land ; his pride.

We visited Isla Perro del Barco Hundido , the Guna community, two natural pools and Chichimeca island; excellent food very good portion.

I recommend visiting them and hiring Guna Yala Explorer
author: Carolina A
